sections.text: Introduction

This document 
outlines the inspection checklist I2 
that must be carried out every 3 months
as indicated by (M3) at the above 
title block. The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 15/5/02 for T1 at Sheraton El Matar 66kv Substation, Cairo zone.

Safety 
Precaution

items:
Work order must be issued and the 
 qualified
 maintenance staff must carry the suitable
 safety category.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, safety belt, breathing mask,

Transformer
 isolation and earthing on all its sides is required.

There is a
 danger of falling into the oil containment pit when working near large power
 transformers.

Be sure that 
 transformer ladder is well fixed for climbing on top of the
 transformer tank.

Switch off from two sides and the 11kv CB out of 
 its location
Switch off the DC supply for the transformer.

sections.text: Work to be carried out

The works that have 
 be done according to MPIS document # T-041-r0
Clean the bushings

Check oil level in 
 bushing

Check oil leakage on 
 upper surface of the transformer

Check oil level in 
 buchultz relay

Check the oil seals 
 over tapchanger container and tighten bolts

Check the earthing 
 system of the transformer and its accessories (arrestors, earthing resistance, 
 marshaling box, etc)

Check fans to be on 
 at 57 oC in oil temperature gauge

Check fans alarm at 
 80 oC in oil temperature gauge

Check fans trip at 
 90 oC in oil temperature gauge

Check fans to be on 
 at 67 oC in winding temperature gauge

Check fans 
 alarm at 85 oC in winding temperature gauge

Check fans 
 trip at 105 oC in winding temperature gauge

Cleaning and 
 lubricating the fan bearing

Check the operation 
 and connections of local control cabinet

Check the operation 
 of control cabinet of tapchanger and clean it

Check tapchanger 
 drive shaft

Clean the radiator 
 and its accessories

Introduction
This document 
outlines the inspection checklist I2 
that must be carried out every 3 months
as indicated by (M3) at the above 
title block. The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 15/5/02 for T1 at Sheraton El Matar 66kv Substation, Cairo zone.
Safety 
Precaution
Work order must be issued and the 
 qualified
 maintenance staff must carry the suitable
 safety category.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, safety belt, breathing mask,
Transformer
 isolation and earthing on all its sides is required.
There is a
 danger of falling into the oil containment pit when working near large power
 transformers.
Be sure that 
 transformer ladder is well fixed for climbing on top of the
 transformer tank.
Switch off from two sides and the 11kv CB out of 
 its location
Putting portable earthing is necessary.
Switch off the DC supply for the transformer.
